description: The AWS::Rekognition::Dataset type creates an Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels dataset.

DatasetArn.markdownDescription:
The ARN of the dataset.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 20  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^(^arn:[a-z\d-]+:rekognition:[a-z\d-]+:\d{12}:project\/[a-zA-Z0-9_.\-]{1,255}\/dataset\/(train|test)\/[0-9]+$)$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes
